description.zh:
WAF实例的接入类型。取值：

- **share**（默认）：表示CNAME接入。

- **hybrid\_cloud\_cname**：表示混合云CNAME接入。
description.en:
The access mode of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **share** (default): onboarding by using a CNAME record.

- **hybrid\_cloud\_cname**: onboarding by using a hybrid cloud CNAME record.
The domain name whose configurations you want to modify.
The ID of the domain name.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。
- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
